critical_steps: For each partition the analysis-error squared norm is at most (m-1)t^2 times the input squared norm.
Triangle inequalities give the two uniform squared envelopes.
A partition selecting exactly one column from each of m source bases produces I +/- a sqrt(m-1) P_h.
The plus construction attains every upper endpoint; the minus construction attains lower endpoints below threshold and zero at threshold for m>=3.
The rank-one source operators remain invertible at the singular-weaving threshold for m>=3.
integrity.proof_basis: Uniform direct-sum coefficient difference inequality and explicit rank-one self-adjoint synthesis spectra in dimension m.
integrity.unproved_limits: No dimension-dependent refinement for a fixed smaller Hilbert space is asserted.

limitations: Only the orthonormal-base, identity-reference operator problem is classified; no optimal modulus for nontight frames is claimed.
The lower zero envelope at and above the threshold is attained among invertible source operators for m>=3; for m=2 only an infimum is asserted.
Searches cannot exclude uncatalogued prior rank-one extremizers or unpublished work.

title: Sharp two-sided perturbation envelopes for operator-woven orthonormal bases
